status: PASS: suitable as a draft serial merge candidate after PR27; not merged

resolved_finding.description: Particle temperature previously widened the gas caloric search interval; an out-of-domain nonmonotone gas polynomial could produce conserved zero exchange.
resolved_finding.change: Use the shared gas validity interval and safeguarded caloric inversion for the centered equation E(T)-Eold+(A/V)*(T-Tref)=sum(w*(Tp-Tref))/V, with derivative Cv(T)+A/V. Preserve actual parcel input temperatures and independent parcel limits. Verify the root residual, including floating-point representation error, before publishing exchange; propagate unresolved solve status through existing per-cell status storage. No new host stopping gate, step retry or fallback.
resolved_finding.conservation: Reverse the actual represented parcel heat to the conserved gas energy as before. Independent tests check the exchange equation as well as total two-phase energy.
resolved_finding.ordinary_caloric_policy: Unchanged; only its temperature-bound intersection is factored into a common helper.

counterexample.reference: Independent long-double analytic root for the fixture linear-Cp polynomial; not another invocation of production inversion.

reference_scope: The six native cases compare against frozen corrected serial CPU executions of production headers in the preserved steady-validation/repair workspace. Their original reference tools and inputs are restored in validation/steady_cpu. These full open-boundary sampling comparisons are not a certification of total mixture energy closure: intrinsic gas FV boundary exchange differs from a porosity-weighted two-phase budget. Closed local transaction tests and the analytic counterexample independently verify conservation.
